Welcome to CrossFit Palm Springs

Your Fitness Community.

You may join for the coaching, classes, and facility. You stay because the people around you make showing up easier, progress more meaningful, and hard workouts a lot more fun.

COACHING THAT MEETS YOU WHERE YOU ARE.

Learn the movement, find the right level, then build from there with a coach in your corner.

Built for real progress

Come for the workout. Stay for the community.

CrossFit Palm Springs is a place to build strength, confidence, and consistency. Our coaches give you personal attention inside a motivating group setting, so you know what to do and how to keep progressing.

Whether you are starting fresh, getting back into training, or ready to push your performance, you will have a version of the workout that challenges you at the right level.

Expert Coaching

A Community That Supports You

All Fitness Levels Welcome

Every workout can be adjusted to your experience and ability. You do not have to get fit before you start.

New to CrossFit?

You’re In The Right Place.

There is no separate beginner class you have to wait for. Beginners are welcome in regular classes, and our coaches adjust movements, loading, and intensity so you can train safely and confidently with the community.

✓Your coach explains the workout and movements.
✓Exercises can be modified to match your current fitness level.
✓You train with the same supportive community from day one.
